name: mummy lord
desc: Mummy Lord is a CR 15 undead.

actions.name: legendary resistance
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: undead restoration
actions.desc: If destroyed, the  [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, reviving with all its Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the  [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s lair. The heart is a Tiny object that has AC 17, HP 10, and Immunity to all damage except Fire.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: rotting fist
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain Hit Points, its Hit Point maximum doesn't return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by [[/r 3d6#HP Max Decrease]]{10 (3d6)} every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item .mmRottingFist000]] or [[/item .d6GVHcFrHv83C7eS]] attack, and it uses [[/item .mmDreadfulGlare0]].

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]], +9 to hit with spell attacks): At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDispelMagi]{Dispel Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplThaumaturg]{Thaumaturgy} 1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplAnimateDea]{Animate Dead}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplHarm000000]{Harm}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplInsectPlag]{Insect Plague} (level 7 version)

actions.name: whirlwind of sand
actions.desc: Trigger: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is hit by an attack roll. Response: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} adds 2 to its AC against the attack, possibly causing the attack to miss, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} teleports up to [[lookup @range.value activity=EsBmMUQMO4b0g6Yw]] [[lookup @range.units activity=EsBmMUQMO4b0g6Yw]]. [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=EsBmMUQMO4b0g6Yw]]. Each creature of its choice that it can see within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=EsBmMUQMO4b0g6Yw]] [[lookup @target.template.units activity=EsBmMUQMO4b0g6Yw]]. of its destination space has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] condition until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn.

actions.name: dread command
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCommand000]{Command} (level 2 version), using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: necrotic strike
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item .mmRottingFist000]] or [[/item .d6GVHcFrHv83C7eS]] attack.

actions.name: dreadful glare
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=8LmlZfevSQkOxGSN]], one [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=8LmlZfevSQkOxGSN]] the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=8LmlZfevSQkOxGSN]] feet. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] condition until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn.
